import re

import clike as C

FILES = C.files([".js"], dirs=["src"])
CHECKS = {"anon_function": ["\\bfunction\\s*\\(", "an anonymous `function` expression"], "concat": ["['\\\"`]\\s*\\+\\s*[\\w(\\[]|[\\w)\\]]\\s*\\+\\s*['\\\"`]", "string concatenation with `+`"], "index_loop": ["\\bfor\\s*\\(\\s*(?:var|let)\\s+\\w+\\s*=\\s*0", "an index-based for loop"], "new_array": ["\\bnew\\s+(?:Array|Object)\\s*\\(\\s*\\)", "`new Array()` / `new Object()`"], "object_assign": ["\\bObject\\.assign\\(", "`Object.assign`"], "var": ["\\bvar\\b", "a `var` declaration"]}
problems = []
text = "\n".join(C.clean(C.read(f), "javascript") for f in FILES)
for key, (pat, what) in CHECKS.items():
    for m in re.finditer(pat, text):
        line = text.count("\n", 0, m.start()) + 1
        problems.append("line %d: %s" % (line, what))
C.report(problems[:12])
